title: Comprehensive review on the integration of self-healing polymers with smart food traceability: scope, application and challenges
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,183-202
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00420A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Krishna Gopalakrishnan, Arnav Bayan, Poonam Mishra
Limited studies are available on embedded symbology techniques for food traceability. This review highlights emerging self-healing materials and technologies to support the development of customized smart traceability systems.
